source.unit: Aphorisms I.19 throughI.25, all seven complete.
source.checked: Francis Adams translation read at MIT.
source.content: The sequence restricts intervention around attacks/crisis; evacuation depends on material state, suitable outlet and tolerance. It includes an exception for material already striving to leave and warns against judging by amount alone.

design.whole_passage_relation: One complete conditional program combines every aphorism; prescription, exception, restraint and outcome assessment remain separate statements. A disease-stage prohibition is not silently overridden by another permission.
two_reused_input_cases: Mature versus unmature material changes permission; the explicit spontaneous-exit exception must remain.
Identical quantity can be appropriate or inappropriate depending on kind and tolerance; amount alone cannot determine outcome.
design.rival: Unconditional evacuation instruction, or a fixed-amount recipe whose quantity alone determines correctness.
design.distinct_consequence: Written guards and exception scope can block an otherwise allowed operation; output quantity is not sufficient evidence of successful action.
design.falsifier: Fail if a full reading executes at the prohibited crisis state without a written scoped exception, or if the same expression must change from permission to factual completion.
design.smallest_step: Build a complete permission/prohibition table from all seven aphorisms before fitting; author all target groups and compare the unconditional rival. No simulator of actual medical efficacy.
new_costs: Potentially conflicting guard scopes must be explicit and reported unresolved if the source does not rank them.
No numerical dosage or modern medical recommendation.
predecessors: IDEA000396 prognosis has a repeated inquiry and different content; this is a prospective treatment-eligibility sequence, not that examination rerun.
design.main_gap: Scope precedence is not automatically supplied by aphorism order; no written target IF/UNLESS or disease-stage term is known.

duplicate_screen.limit: Common-design vocabulary dominated ranking. Targeted source searches and predecessor primary reads above provide navigation; no novelty certification.

source_obligation_cautions: Retain the historical extreme-evacuation clause and its patient-support condition; do not simplify these away.
